mask_model: SAM3.1 native image detector; independent frames; CPU ROI Align
limits: Masks and matches are proposals. Reference plane assumes one level floor; actual steps/slopes or bad depth can also cause disagreement. Plane checks cannot detect in-plane translation/yaw or absolute scale. Depth reprojection mixes camera and depth errors. Repeated tiles can produce false homographies. Epipolar errors are native pixels; homography and depth errors are at 540x960. No cameras or scenes corrected.
